context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix for object count issue verified. The embii profile (address: 16rb9yA7FYQPTUpwZJsWZV77fWUUGsfGpw) on btc-mainnet now correctly shows 186 objects (matching SUP reference client). The fix was to include objects where the address appears in either Owners OR Creators dict, since in P2FK protocol creators are implicit owners. Test file created at /app/backend/tests/test_object_counts_fix.py for regression testing.
